setup: What is the examinations office responsible for?
question: Tell me more about it
notes: Multi-turn: a short pronoun-heavy follow-up ('it') must combine with the previous turn for retrieval (_is_context_dependent_followup / _build_retrieval_query) and stay on the same topic, rather than retrieving unrelated chunks for 'tell me more about it' in isolation. Asserts topic continuity via any of several markers rather than the literal subject name: the system prompt tells the model to organise answers under its own headings and not restate the question, so demanding it repeat 'Examinations Office' verbatim tested our own formatting rule, not pronoun resolution. expected_absent catches the real failure mode - drifting to an unrelated topic.

question: How many times can I retake a failed module exam?
notes: Fact from the MPO_AEDS_2026_EN.pdf (examination regulations, Section 8(1)). Also guards against a since-fixed bug where _strip_fabricated_citations mangled 'Section 8(1) of the ...' into '...8(1) o' + 'f the ...' by greedily consuming a stray letter from the following prose - 'to f the' only appears in the broken form ('According to f the'), not the correct 'According to of the'. Accepts any equivalent wording of "two" - the fact under test is the number of resits, not the phrasing.
